metadata.title: Autodesk Inventor Weldment Operations — Weldment Environment
metadata.description: Parameter catalog for the Inventor Weldment environment — a specialized assembly subtype activated by Convert-to-Weldment. Weldments enforce a 3-phase build order in the browser: (1) Preparations (cope / chamfer / fillet edge prep cuts), (2) Weld Beads (cosmetic annotation-only, fillet with material, groove with material), (3) Machining (post-weld features like through-holes / faces that span the now-welded body). The order is enforced because changing geometry beneath an existing bead would invalidate the bead's material; adding machining before welds would split the weld features off the wrong body. Catalog covers ~12 operations across the three phases plus weld symbol annotation, end-fill caps, multi-pass weld scheduling, and weldment-specific BOM. Bindings reference WeldmentComponentDefinition COM API (Preparations / WeldBeads / Machining collections + AddFilletWeldBead / AddCosmeticWeldBead / AddGrooveWeldBead methods + WeldSymbol drawing-side annotation). Welding Standard (ANSI/ISO/DIN/JIS/AWS) carries through to symbol generation and BOM unit conventions.
metadata.source: Autodesk Inventor 2025 Help — Weldment Reference; Inventor API Reference — Weldment namespace (WeldmentComponentDefinition, Preparations.AddCopeFeature / AddChamferFeature / AddFilletEdgeFeature, WeldBeads.AddFilletWeldBead / AddCosmeticWeldBead / AddGrooveWeldBead, WeldEndFillFeature, MachiningFeatures, WeldPasses, WeldSymbol drawing annotation); Welding Standards: AWS A2.4 / ISO 2553 / ANSI Y14.5

commonTabs.description: Standard parameter tabs across Inventor Weldment features. Weld bead operations split across Selection / Bead / Termination / Symbol tabs to mirror the Inventor weld dialog organization.

CONVERT_TO_WELDMENT.description: Convert a standard assembly into a weldment. This adds the three weldment browser folders (Preparations, Welds, Machining) and switches the assembly-level operation set. Welding Standard governs symbol notation, default unit conventions for bead size, and BOM weld-length aggregation. Default bead style is applied to subsequent weld bead features unless overridden per-bead. Conversion is reversible (Convert-to-Assembly), but reverting deletes all weld bead features.

parameters.name: Welding Standard
parameters.description: Welding symbol convention applied to drawings + symbol features

parameters.name: Default Material
parameters.description: Material assigned to weld bead bodies (typically matches base material)

parameters.name: Default Bead Style
parameters.description: Inventor bead-style preset (controls bead body color + appearance)

parameters.name: Weld Body Color Override
parameters.description: Render override for visual distinction in the assembly view

parameters.name: Weld Bead Display in BOM
parameters.description: Surface weld bead bodies as line items in the assembly BOM (vs hidden)

parameters.name: Allow Welds to Modify Original Parts
parameters.description: When false, weld features create new bodies but leave parent part files untouched

PREPARATION_COPE.description: Cope (saddle) preparation cut on a tubular member to fit it against another tube/cylindrical face. Creates a curved cut in the coping member matching the obstacle's outside diameter. Used for tubular T / Y / K joints in pipe/tube fabrication. The cope reaches a controlled depth (Gap parameter) so root opening is preserved for the subsequent weld pass.

parameters.name: Coping Member
parameters.description: Member to receive the cope cut

parameters.name: Coping Body
parameters.description: Cylindrical/tubular body the cope conforms to

parameters.name: Gap
parameters.description: Material gap left between coped surface and obstacle (root opening)

parameters.name: Approach Angle
parameters.description: Angle between coping member and obstacle (auto-detected if 0)

parameters.name: Through Cut
parameters.description: Cope all the way through (for thin-wall tubes)

PREPARATION_CHAMFER.description: Chamfer edge preparation for groove (V / bevel / J / U) welds. Creates a chamfered groove face on selected edges so subsequent groove weld bead has correct angle for full-penetration root pass. Chamfer angle + distance correspond to the groove standards in AWS A2.4 / ISO 9692.

parameters.name: Edges
parameters.description: Edge(s) to chamfer

parameters.name: Chamfer Angle
parameters.description: Included groove angle (per side for V/double-V)

parameters.name: Chamfer Distance
parameters.description: Edge offset depth

parameters.name: Both Sides
parameters.description: Apply chamfer to both adjoining members at the joint

parameters.name: Root Face
parameters.description: Unchamfered land at edge bottom (typical 1.5–3 mm)

PREPARATION_FILLET.description: Edge fillet (rounding) preparation along a joint edge — reduces stress concentration before fillet weld is applied. Distinct from a fillet *weld* (PREPARATION_FILLET adds a small radius to the corner; FILLET_WELD_BEAD adds material).

parameters.name: Edges
parameters.description: Edge(s) to round

parameters.name: Fillet Radius
parameters.description: Edge fillet radius

parameters.name: Both Sides
parameters.description: Apply to both adjoining edges

parameters.name: Variable Radius
parameters.description: Apply variable radius along edge (uses point-radius pairs)

parameters.name: Variable Radius Points
parameters.description: Count of variable-radius control points (when Variable Radius is true)

COSMETIC_WELD_BEAD.description: Annotation-only weld bead — no material body added. Documents the welding intent and surfaces in BOMs and symbol outputs without affecting mass / interference / collision analysis. Most often used in preliminary design or for tack welds + small fillet welds where bead volume is negligible. Intermittent stitch parameters (pitch + length) drive AWS-style stitch annotation in drawings.

parameters.name: Edges
parameters.description: Edge(s) the bead follows

parameters.name: Bead Type
parameters.description: Weld type per AWS A2.4 / ISO 2553

parameters.name: Leg Size
parameters.description: Fillet leg / groove face / spot diameter

parameters.name: Length
parameters.description: Continuous bead length (0 = full edge)

parameters.name: All Around
parameters.description: AWS 'all-around' circle annotation

parameters.name: Intermittent
parameters.description: Enable stitch-weld pattern

parameters.name: Stitch Length
parameters.description: Per-stitch bead length (when intermittent)

parameters.name: Stitch Pitch
parameters.description: Center-to-center spacing between stitches

parameters.name: Stitch Count
parameters.description: Optional total stitch count override

parameters.name: Field Weld
parameters.description: AWS field-weld flag annotation

parameters.name: Tail Text
parameters.description: Free-text tail annotation (e.g., 'Typ 4 Places')

FILLET_WELD_BEAD.description: Solid fillet weld with material body. Two-face fillet (most common) or three-face for socket welds. The bead's prismatic body is generated along the joint, sized by leg length. Inventor computes mass + center-of-mass + interference per bead. Concave / convex / flat contours follow AWS A2.4 supplementary symbol library.

parameters.name: Face Set 1
parameters.description: First face (or face group) defining the joint

parameters.name: Face Set 2
parameters.description: Second face (or face group) defining the joint

parameters.name: Face Set 3
parameters.description: Optional third face (socket / 3-face fillet)

parameters.name: Leg 1 Length
parameters.description: Leg length on Face Set 1

parameters.name: Leg 2 Length
parameters.description: Leg length on Face Set 2 (defaults to Leg 1 for equal-leg)

parameters.name: Throat Depth
parameters.description: Effective throat (auto-computed from legs unless overridden)

parameters.name: Contour
parameters.description: Bead contour per AWS A2.4 supplementary symbols

parameters.name: All Around
parameters.description: Apply bead to entire perimeter of joint

parameters.name: Intermittent
parameters.description: Stitch-weld pattern (vs continuous)

parameters.name: Stitch Length
parameters.description: Per-stitch bead length

parameters.name: Stitch Pitch
parameters.description: Stitch center-to-center spacing

parameters.name: Direction
parameters.description: Where the bead grows from

parameters.name: Termination Treatment
parameters.description: End-cap geometry of the bead body

GROOVE_WELD_BEAD.description: Groove weld bead — fills the groove created by PREPARATION_CHAMFER (or by member geometry). Full-penetration grooves require the groove geometry to be open through the joint thickness; partial-penetration uses a depth parameter. Root opening, root face, and reinforcement are surfaced for downstream weld inspection / NDT documentation.

parameters.name: Groove Faces
parameters.description: Groove sidewalls (typically the chamfered faces)

parameters.name: Root Edge
parameters.description: Optional root edge (auto-detected if omitted)

parameters.name: Penetration
parameters.description: Full-penetration vs partial-penetration groove

parameters.name: Groove Depth
parameters.description: Depth of fill (when partial penetration); ignored for full-penetration

parameters.name: Root Opening
parameters.description: Gap at the joint root

parameters.name: Reinforcement
parameters.description: Bead crown above the surface (typical 1–3 mm)

parameters.name: Root Face
parameters.description: Unfused face at root (carries from preparation)

parameters.name: Backing Bar
parameters.description: Include backing bar geometry on the back side

parameters.name: Melt-Through Backing
parameters.description: Show melt-through annotation in symbol

parameters.name: Both Sides
parameters.description: Apply same groove from both sides (double-V / double-bevel)

parameters.name: All Around
parameters.description: Apply around full joint perimeter

MACHINING_FEATURE.description: Post-weld machining feature applied to the welded assembly as a single body. Used for through-holes / pockets / faces that span the now-welded structure (e.g., bolt-pattern hole through a welded base plate). Inventor enforces this as the third browser phase: machining always operates on the post-weld unified body, never on the pre-weld parts.

parameters.name: Profile
parameters.description: Sketch profile or selection (semantics depend on Feature Type)

parameters.name: Distance
parameters.description: Termination distance (when Termination=distance)

parameters.name: Notes
parameters.description: Machining note text — surfaces in BOM and drawing tables

WELD_SYMBOL.description: Drawing-side weld symbol annotation per AWS A2.4 / ISO 2553. Symbols are placed on a drawing view and reference the underlying weld feature(s) by association — changing the bead automatically updates the symbol. Supports multiple-side notation (arrow side / other side), all-around, field weld, finish symbols (G/M/C/H), and tail text for process / specification reference.

parameters.name: All Around
parameters.description: All-around symbol circle

parameters.name: Field Weld
parameters.description: Field-weld flag

parameters.name: Size
parameters.description: Weld size (e.g., '6 mm' for fillet leg, depth-of-prep for groove)

parameters.name: Length
parameters.description: Weld length annotation (e.g., '50' or '50-150')

parameters.name: Pitch
parameters.description: Stitch pitch (e.g., '50-150' for 50 mm stitch / 150 mm pitch)

parameters.name: Root Opening
parameters.description: Root opening callout

parameters.name: Groove Angle
parameters.description: Included groove angle

parameters.name: Finish Symbol
parameters.description: Finish symbol per AWS supplementary list

parameters.name: Tail Text
parameters.description: Process / specification reference (e.g., 'GMAW / AWS D1.1')

END_FILL.description: End-fill cap that closes voids at the open ends of welded tubular / hollow members. Common on frame-end caps where an end-plug or cap is welded to seal the tube. Generates a small body matching the cross-section of the opening, then attaches it to the parent member via a fillet bead boundary.

parameters.name: Open End
parameters.description: End face / opening to cap

parameters.name: Treatment
parameters.description: Add cap body, extend existing material, or annotation-only

parameters.name: Cap Thickness
parameters.description: Cap material thickness (when Treatment=cap)

parameters.name: Material Override
parameters.description: Cap material (defaults to parent member material)

WELD_PASSES.description: Multi-pass weld schedule for thick-section groove welds. Decomposes a single groove bead into root pass + filler passes + cap pass(es), each with its own size + electrode + heat input. Inventor stores the schedule as metadata against the parent groove bead — bead body geometry remains unchanged.

parameters.name: Bead Reference
parameters.description: Parent groove weld bead to annotate

parameters.name: Pass Count
parameters.description: Total number of passes (root + filler + cap)

parameters.name: Root Pass Size
parameters.description: Root pass leg / fill depth

parameters.name: Filler Pass Size
parameters.description: Per-filler-pass fill depth (uniform)

parameters.name: Cap Pass Size
parameters.description: Cap pass fill depth

parameters.name: Process
parameters.description: Welding process per AWS designation

WELDMENT_BOM.description: Weldment-specific Bill of Materials with weld-feature aggregation: bead-by-bead bead length / bead volume / weld pass count / electrode mass estimate, alongside the standard parts table. Used by fabricators for welder cut-list, electrode procurement, and process planning. Output formats include the standard Inventor parts list as well as weld-procedure spreadsheet exports.

parameters.name: Include Bead Length
parameters.description: Per-bead bead length column

parameters.name: Include Bead Volume
parameters.description: Per-bead bead volume + electrode mass estimate

parameters.name: Include Pass Count
parameters.description: Per-bead weld pass count column (from WELD_PASSES schedules)

parameters.name: Electrode Density
parameters.description: Electrode density used for mass estimate (default carbon steel)

parameters.name: Deposition Efficiency
parameters.description: Weld deposition efficiency (0..1) for electrode mass estimate

parameters.name: Output Path
parameters.description: Filesystem path for emitted file (only for xlsx/csv/xml/weld_procedure_form)
